# notes: DIFFERENT CODE (same system as R9588): groups ~100-1100 plus 1405/1415/1657/1697/1698/1858/1930/1952; frequent 224 1043 1698 294 784 319. Many groups carry short overbars (not all marked here). Pencil interlinear decipherment on p2 is SYLLABIC (e.g. 'cam bia', 'sol tan za' = sostanza), which suggests this code is syllabic/partly syllabic. Undated; signed only 'Castelcicala'. Transcribed mainly from the 1600px copies plus spot crops: expect some digit errors. 97800 as written.
